capabilities: Turn PDF pages by tapping side zones or swiping
Navigate pages with keyboard keys or Bluetooth pedals that send them
Fit whole pages to the screen and snap scrolling to page tops
Expand one PDF over the workspace in focus mode
Show on-screen previous and next buttons over the PDF
extras: Installable via BRAT as a beta plugin; relies on Obsidian's internal pdf.js viewer, which may break with Obsidian updates; works on desktop, iOS, and Android (Obsidian 1.5.0+).
problem: Obsidian's built-in PDF viewer has no sheet-music-style page turning, so musicians reading PDF scores cannot flip pages hands-free while playing.
summary: PDF page-turning helper that turns pages with tap zones, swipes, keyboard keys, Bluetooth pedals, and page-fit scrolling.
